mapper.insert: insert into activity (title, description, location, start_time, end_time, capacity, enrolled_count, status) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity}, #{enrolledCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: update activity set enrolled_count = enrolled_count + 1 where id = #{id} and capacity > enrolled_count

update activity a join( select activity_id from activity_enrollment where id = #{enrollmentId} and status = 2 ) t on a.id = t.activity_id set a.enrolled_count = a.enrolled_count - 1 where a.enrolled_count >= 1
mapper.select: select id, title, description, location, start_time, end_time, capacity, enrolled_count, status from activity where id = #{id}

select id, title, description, location, start_time, end_time, capacity, enrolled_count, status from activity a
and a.status = #{status}
and a.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by a.start_time, a.id
